description: This file defines types, functions, and constants for parsing and handling image references in a container registry context, including support for tags, digests, and repository naming conventions.

classes.name: reference
classes.description: Internal struct representing a reference with optional tag and digest.

classes.name: repository
classes.description: Internal struct representing a repository with domain and path components.

classes.name: digestReference
classes.description: Type alias for digest.Digest representing a digest-only reference.

classes.name: taggedReference
classes.description: Type representing a tagged reference with a repository and tag.

classes.name: canonicalReference
classes.description: Type representing a canonical reference with a repository and digest.

methods.name: AsField
methods.description: Wraps a Reference in a Field for encoding.

methods.name: Reference
methods.description: Unwraps the reference type from a Field.

methods.name: UnmarshalText
methods.description: Parses text bytes into a Field, invoking Parse.

methods.name: Name
methods.description: Returns the full name of a repository.

methods.name: Domain
methods.description: Returns the domain part of a Named reference.

methods.name: Path
methods.description: Returns the path part of a Named reference.

methods.name: Parse
methods.description: Parses a string into a Reference object.

methods.name: ParseNamed
methods.description: Parses a string into a Named reference in canonical form.

methods.name: WithName
methods.description: Creates a Named reference from a string.

methods.name: WithTag
methods.description: Creates a NamedTagged reference from a name and tag.

methods.name: WithDigest
methods.description: Creates a Canonical reference from a name and digest.

methods.name: TrimNamed
methods.description: Removes tag or digest from a Named reference.

methods.name: String
methods.description: Returns string representation of reference, repository, digestReference, taggedReference, or canonicalReference.

methods.name: Tag
methods.description: Returns the tag of a taggedReference.

methods.name: Digest
methods.description: Returns the digest of a digestReference or canonicalReference.
